d: Jeremiah Fears made history against the Golden State Warriors, recording an impressive 19 points, 10 rebounds and 10 assists for his first career triple-double! At just 20 years and 33 days old, Fears surpassed Chris Paul to become the youngest player in New Orleans Pelicans franchise history to record a triple-double, breaking a record Paul set back in 2006. His historic performance helped lead the Pelicans to a dominant 115-94 victory, improving their record to 5-10 while the Warriors fell to 8-6.
